model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the proportion of veterans in the population over time, with the x-axis labeled 'Year' spanning from 1960 to 2010 in 10-year increments on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled 'Veterans as share of population' ranging from 0 to 15% in 5% increments on a linear scale. A single red line with circle markers and a solid style represents the data, starting at approximately 12.8% in 1960, peaking at 13.8% in 1970, and then declining to 12.1% in 1980, 11.0% in 1990, 9.4% in 2000, and finally reaching 7% in 2010.
